description: This file contains test cases for validating the behavior of agent directory validation in a multi-agent system configuration. It uses Vitest testing framework to verify that shared agent directories are correctly identified as duplicates and errors are thrown during configuration loading.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for multi-agent agentDir validation.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for specific validation scenarios.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts expected outcomes within test cases.

methods.name: vi.spyOn
methods.description: Creates a spy on console.error to mock its implementation during testing.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and validates the configuration, throwing an error if duplicate agentDir entries are found.

methods.name: validateConfigObject
methods.description: Validates the configuration object structure, specifically the agents list and their directories.

methods.name: withTempHomeConfig
methods.description: Sets up a temporary configuration environment for testing and runs provided async function.
